evals.name: design-measurement
evals.prompt: 実在の Web サイトを開いて、フォントサイズの階層・余白・配色・CSS 変数を測定して、サイト間で比較できる形で JSON に出すスクリプトを書きたい。Playwright で各ページを開いて computed style を集める方向で考えてる。書いてもらえる?
evals.expected_output: Restates the goal implementation-independently (not 'a Playwright script'), searches under domain terms like design tokens / computed style extraction / web design mining, surfaces concrete existing tools with URLs, reaches an explicit 採用/改造/部分自作/自作 verdict with grounds, and writes a research document including a 見送った候補と理由 section.
assertions: Restates the goal in implementation-independent terms rather than accepting 'Playwright script' as the frame
Searches using domain vocabulary beyond the user's own words (e.g. design tokens, computed style extraction, web design mining/census, visual regression)
Names at least 3 concrete existing tools/projects/papers with a URL or citation for each
States one of the four verdicts (採用/改造/部分自作/自作) explicitly with grounds
If the verdict is 自作, lists what was examined and why each was rejected (not merely 'nothing found')
Produces a research document file with a 見送った候補と理由 section
Does not write the implementation script

evals.name: hidden-domain
evals.prompt: 取引先から来る商品マスタCSVと、うちの社内マスタCSVを突き合わせたい。商品名の表記がバラバラ(全角半角、"(株)"の有無、型番の区切り、スペース)で完全一致だと全然ヒットしない。名前の似てる度合いで候補を出して人が確認する感じにしたい。似てる度合いの計算は、共通の文字数を数えて割合を出す感じで自前で書こうと思ってる。
evals.expected_output: Identifies that this is the established field of record linkage / entity resolution / fuzzy matching, names the standard vocabulary (Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, token-set ratio, blocking, NFKC normalization), surfaces real libraries (rapidfuzz, recordlinkage, dedupe, splink), and warns the user's hand-rolled 'count common characters' metric is a known-weak approach.
assertions: Names the domain explicitly (record linkage / entity resolution / fuzzy matching / 名寄せ)
Surfaces established similarity metrics by name (e.g. Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, token set ratio) rather than only the user's proposed metric
Names at least 2 real libraries with URLs (e.g. rapidfuzz, recordlinkage, dedupe, splink, fuzzywuzzy)
Raises normalization as a distinct prior step (NFKC / 全角半角 / 法人格表記) rather than folding it into similarity scoring
Explicitly evaluates the user's proposed self-built metric rather than silently accepting it
Reaches an explicit verdict recommending existing tooling over the hand-rolled approach

evals.name: bounded-no-overreach
evals.prompt: scripts/measure.mjs の 42行目あたり、viewport の幅が narrow のときだけ font-size の測定値が 0 で返ってくる。たぶん要素がまだレンダリングされてないうちに読んでる。直して。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a bounded bug fix in existing code and does NOT run a prior-art survey. Should go straight to inspecting the code / diagnosing. The skill must not fire here, or if consulted, must be explicitly set aside as disproportionate.
assertions: Does NOT produce a prior-art research document
Does NOT perform web searches for existing libraries
Goes directly to inspecting/diagnosing the specific bug
Total response stays proportionate to a small bug fix (no multi-phase research program)
